New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to get the latest episodes as soon as they're available.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • AT&T appears to have no plans to support Handoff on Apple's new iPhones
  • Disney+ and Hulu raise prices again—here are the latest rates
  • Apple says software fix for iPhone 18 Pro reboot issue coming next week
  • Some users experiencing Face ID failures causing crashes and reboots on iPhone 18 Pro
  • iOS 27.0.1 update rolling out soon for iPhone
